evidence: Native ExifTool PNG/GIF interoperability requires real paths and process execution. it.layer excludes test services; absence skips and other version failures propagate.

replacement.sketch: Real ExifTool process and PNG/GIF filesystem interoperability are the subject; MemoryFileSystem paths cannot be consumed by that process. Retain native NodeServices through it.layer with excludeTestServices:true and scoped temporary paths. Historical it.live calls were replaced by inner it.effect; native requirement remains. Missing binary is an explicit dynamic skip and other version failures propagate.
